name: copilot-studio
note: Microsoft Copilot Studio, 'Quotas and limits' page (Copilot Studio web app limits: 500 uploaded files and 500 knowledge sources per agent, 512 MB per file; unstructured data limits: file types doc, docx, xls, xlsx, ppt, pptx, pdf and 10 levels of subfolders). Files under about 4 KB fall back to document-level citations. max_total_bytes 0 means the page states no total cap.
